out.rationale: The authors explicitly say their observations are consistent with Khan et al. text: The authors find that on TruthfulQA the judge's (Guard's) performance in their debate game scales with general intelligence rating while debater (Houdini) performance stays constant, with similar scaling on QuALITY and PrOntoQA but mostly flat performance for both Guards and Houdinis on BoolQ. They state that their observations are consistent with Khan et al. (2024), who find that judge accuracy may improve with better models, and add that prior work tested only a few models and did not explicitly compare different judges.
title: Debate judge (Guard) performance scales with general intelligence on TruthfulQA, consistent with Khan et al.
